description: This file defines a React component called DraftPersonaClient that reads a JSON object representing a 'draft persona' from local storage. It provides a UI to display the persona's details, highlights, core competencies, and raw JSON data, with options to refresh and navigate back to ingestion. The code includes utility functions for safe JSON parsing and data coercion to handle legacy data formats.

methods.name: safeJsonParse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string safely, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Transforms various input formats into a standardized array of CareerHighlightItem objects.
